hook: A good reputation is a trap you build for yourself, and other people live in it rent-free.
full_script: A good reputation is a trap you build for yourself, and other people live in it rent-free. You spend decades saying yes to things you hate just to maintain the image of being dependable. But the day you finally say no, they forget twenty years of devotion in twenty seconds. In human hierarchy, people do not fall in love with your character; they fall in love with your convenience. The moment you become inconvenient, your loyalty is rewritten as arrogance. The person who tries to be liked by everyone is respected by no one. Universal approval is the currency of cowards. Stop sacrificing your peace to protect an image held by people who don't care about your soul. Burn the pedestal, and reclaim your sovereignty.
